description: Small system tools: status (battery/CPU/RAM), volume, clipboard, brightness, window list. stdlib only.
name: system

tools.description: Battery %, CPU count/load, RAM total/free. Read-only.
tools.name: system_status

tools.description: Read the master volume level. Often UNAVAILABLE (see SKILL.md honesty notes); returns ok=false with a reason instead of a fake number.
tools.name: volume_get

tools.description: Nudge volume up/down by steps (1-10). Windows: VK_VOLUME_* key synthesis (no level readback — see SKILL.md). Linux: amixer if present.
tools.name: volume_set

tools.description: Read the clipboard text. Content is DCL-scanned and redacted before return — SECRETS never leave this tool raw.
tools.name: clipboard_get

tools.description: Write text to the clipboard (mutating). The caller is responsible for having user intent; DCL refuses to store SECRET-class text.
tools.name: clipboard_set

tools.description: Read display brightness. Currently NOT IMPLEMENTED (honest stub) — see SKILL.md.
tools.name: brightness_get

tools.description: Set display brightness. Currently NOT IMPLEMENTED (honest stub) — see SKILL.md.
tools.name: brightness_set

tools.description: List open window titles from the UIA root children (Windows). Honest empty result elsewhere.
tools.name: window_list
